title: Stump Grinding quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Residential stump grinding at the Smith's residence, 14 Acacia Street, Sunnybank. Includes grinding of three stumps: one large Gum tree stump (ninety-centimetre diameter, thirty-centimetre below ground level), with extensive surface roots requiring grinding across a two-metre radius; one medium Melaleuca stump (sixty-centimetre diameter, twenty-five-centimetre below ground level), located zero point five metres from a retaining wall; and one small Bottlebrush stump (forty-centimetre diameter, twenty-centimetre below ground level). All ground material to be removed. Backfill all three areas with premium garden soil, then cover with native hardwood mulch. Comprehensive site clean-up and green waste removal included.
workingDetail: Stump grinding (below ground level), Root grinding (surface roots), Backfill soil or mulch, Turf patch (optional)
